brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail as a landscape PNG, 1536 x 864 pixels, approximately 16:9. It is for バスケまとめ, a pregame article. This is a NEW illustration, not a photograph.

Visual reference direction: the approved black-and-lime basketball thumbnail shown earlier: deep near-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory lettering, dry brush strokes and visible hand-drawn ink hatching. Strong expressive editorial sports illustration, few elements, highly legible bold Japanese typography. Do not copy any names, stats, dates, score, player, or exact composition from the style reference.

Subject: exactly one real professional player, Fuga Aramoto / 新本 風河 of Mie, selected randomly from the names listed in the source article. Use the official portrait just inspected ONLY as a guide to his actual appearance; do not paste or reproduce the photo. Appearance observed in that official portrait: young Japanese adult, straight glossy black hair parted near the center with curved curtains over the upper forehead and ears partly visible, no beard or moustache, smooth oval-to-squared face with full cheeks and a firm tapered jaw, straight dark eyebrows, dark slightly narrow almond-shaped eyes, straight medium nose, closed defined lips, medium warm skin, compact athletic build and strong shoulders. Make him recognizably consistent with the portrait rather than a generic invented player, while clearly hand-drawn and nonphotorealistic.
Clothing: a plain orange basketball jersey with black edging, a plain black short-sleeve undershirt and dark shorts. Absolutely no logos, sponsor text, team wordmarks, brand marks, names, or uniform numbers anywhere.

Action / composition: player occupies the left 47% of frame, in a dynamic low forward-driving dribble, knees bent, shoulders leaning diagonally toward the center, head lifted with focused eyes. Draw a three-quarter view of his face so the facial features and center-parted hair remain clear. One hand controlling a single orange basketball down near the thigh, the other arm naturally balancing. Hands must have correct human anatomy and plausible five fingers, with natural ball contact. Keep the entire head, face, both hands and the entire basketball inside the canvas with clear padding; an intentional lower-thigh crop is acceptable. Use ivory ink highlights and black hatch shadows with restrained orange on jersey and ball. This is a generic imagined basketball movement, not a reconstruction of an actual game, scoring play, appearance or performance. Do not add other people.
Background: near-black negative space, a few energetic diagonal lime brush marks behind the player. Keep the right half clean for text. No real arena, team logos, league logos, scoreboard, trophies or statistics.

Japanese text, rendered exactly and only as follows:
Top right, medium: "11/05 B.NEXT"
Right headline, large ivory: "品川 × 三重"
Right central headline, very large lime, two stacked lines: "試合前" and "チェック"
Below headline, medium ivory: "今季平均EFF・登録選手"
Below that, clearly readable ivory: "出場確定ではありません"
Bottom left on a clean dark footer strip, clearly readable: "イラスト（AI生成）／イメージ"
Bottom right, smaller but legible: "11/05 04:48 JST時点"

Text hierarchy: the matchup and two-line pregame headline dominate. All text has wide safe margins and strong contrast, no collision with the player or ball. Clean balanced layout suitable for a small website thumbnail. Exact Japanese glyphs, no missing letters. Do not write the player's name, his statistics, his participation, or any claim about his success anywhere in the image. No final score, winner, performance values, or actual-game claim. The source article is pregame and is based on season-average EFF and current registered players, and does not confirm participation. Preserve the AI-generated illustration label and the word イメージ.

ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION:
Edit this basketball thumbnail once to fix framing only, retaining its black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B hand-drawn editorial ink illustration, typography, exact Japanese text, orange jersey, single real player Fuga Aramoto, action and overall layout.
The top of the player's hair is currently cut by the upper edge and the ball is too near the left edge. Scale the whole illustrated player and basketball down about 13 percent and reposition within the LEFT HALF so there is at least 45 pixels of uninterrupted dark background above the entire crown of his hair, and at least 40 pixels between the basketball and left canvas edge. Keep his complete head, both hands, both elbows and entire ball visible. His lower thighs can meet the dark footer. Keep him large and clearly the visual subject, in the same dynamic low dribble. Preserve the center-parted black hair, clean-shaven face and original facial likeness; no new person. Both hands remain anatomically correct with five plausible fingers.
Keep ALL right-side typography identical to the input, its hierarchy and exact content:
11/05 B.NEXT
品川 × 三重
試合前
チェック
今季平均EFF・登録選手
出場確定ではありません
Keep the footer wording exactly:
イラスト（AI生成）／イメージ
11/05 04:48 JST時点
